messages:
emma: hey team, new joiner here — opened my first PR but GitHub says "required checks failing" and won't let me merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood/example/pull/314
jonah: welcome @emma! can you paste the failing check name or screenshot? sometimes org SSO or app permissions cause phantom failures.
emma: the PR shows a red X for 'github/actions' but the Actions run log says it couldn't set the check: 
```
Request to POST /repos/redwood/example/check-runs returned 403
Resource not accessible by integration
```
srini: ah, that message usually means the GitHub App or workflow tried to write a check run but doesn't have write permission for that repo (common for forks or when the app lost permissions). is this from a fork or an in-repo branch?
emma: fork — i forked the repo and opened the PR from my fork branch.
infra-oncall: for forks, workflows get a limited token and apps may be blocked from writing back. we also recently tightened the org app installation scope which might be preventing the actions bot from writing statuses. two options: (1) push a branch directly to the main repo (preferred for CI that mutates PR), or (2) infra can temporarily re-grant the app write scope and re-run.
jonah: onboarding tip: new hires often fork by default. we recommend creating a feature branch in-repo for changes that require bots/apps to post back. we should add that to the checklist.
emma: i'd prefer not to reconfigure org apps. i can push a branch to the main repo  how do i get permission to create branches?
infra-oncall: you should already have the repo push rights via your org membership. if you hit an error, ping me. if you want, @jonah and i can mirror the fork into a branch for you.
emma: thanks — if you can mirror it that would be great.
buildkite-bot: buildkite pipeline "redwood-ci/main" queued for PR #314 (job id: bk-31421).
gha-bot: check-suite for commit abcdef: completed (some write steps skipped due to permissions)
infra-oncall: mirrored branch pushed: users/emma/first-pr. re-triggering CI on that branch now.
buildkite-bot: buildkite pipeline "redwood-ci/main" started for PR #314 (job id: bk-31422).
infra-oncall: follow-up: i filed infra ticket INF-1223 to review app install scopes; we might add a note to the new-hire doc about forks vs in-repo branches for CI.
emma: build passed e0, merge button enabled, merged. thanks everyone! excited to be here :tada:
jonah: welcome aboard @emma! i'll add the fork note to the onboarding checklist and put a small blurb in the handbook about common 403s for new hires.
